items.title: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia
items.description: The closure of the U.N. Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) follows a two-year transition agreed with the federal government. It was replaced by the U.N. Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) in 2013 before entering its final transition phase as UNTMIS in 2024. items.description: Multiple sources reported fierce clashes in the area, with initial accounts indicating significant losses among federal government forces.
